purpose: We are preparing a public health planning report on regional dialysis capacity for a provincial government client and need the prevalence of chronic kidney disease per region as input.
question: How many adults have chronic kidney disease in each region and what is the prevalence?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Chronic kidney disease = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with N18.
Prevalence = adults with chronic kidney disease / all adults in the region × 100, one decimal.
Report per region: adults, adults with chronic kidney disease and the prevalence.

expected.reason: The purpose is allowed (Art. 53). A health data request is answered only with anonymised statistics; the applicant never sees the data (Art. 69). The applicant states it acts on behalf of a public sector body (Art. 53(2)); staff must verify the mandate before release.

judge.why: Rule 2: a private management consultancy whose purpose is only a public health planning report for a government client fits public health and policy-making alone, so Art. 53(2) bars it.

review: Blind review 2026-10-30: the applicant processes on behalf of a public body, which Art. 53(2) covers ('including where processing ... is done by a third party on behalf of those public sector bodies'); REJECT [53] is contestable, human call needed; settled 2026-10-30 by the Art. 53(2) third-party clause decision: approved as statistics, flagged for staff to verify the mandate
